_note: The usual sharp anchor is temporarily unavailable, so movers are computed from fanduel then draftkings prices (each mover names its book in source). This is that book's view of the line, ranked by how far the implied probability moved (abs_max_prob_delta_pp), not raw cents -- so a 200-cent wobble on a 97% favorite does not outrank a genuine 3-point steam move. Markets that moved fewer than 1.0 probability point(s) are filtered as noise, and a game carried under multiple sport-key aliases is shown once. pre_game_only=true (default) filters out in-play events whose live-game price collapse would otherwise dominate.
